post.description: Bind a preprovisioned wearable using its one-time pairing credential.

get.description: Authorized session/partner summary for the phone to relay to the wearable.

post.description:
Idempotent upload of direct wearable scan observations.

Identity is (observer, token, captured_at): a retransmitted observation
is a duplicate and cannot refresh presence; only a new physical
reception (new captured_at) can. Old rows are pruned past a generous
window; presence itself is derived at query time from the 15 s rule.

put.description: Edit display name + discovery profile fields atomically.

Flip the separate Bluetooth/GPS discovery opt-ins.

The server suppresses an opted-out user immediately on every query,
regardless of device connectivity; the phone relays the change to the
wearable's radio on its next link.

post.description:
Return the bound wearable's live discovery token, creating one if
absent. rotate=true invalidates the previous value (also done on device
unbind/reassignment). Provisioned only through this authenticated link.

put.description: Mirror the wearable's bonding choice. Cosmetic only — no XP/points.

post.description:
Claim the daily care XP: +10 XP at most once per user per calendar day.

The wearable performs care locally and relays the event through the phone;
offline days sync later but the server cap is absolute. Idempotent per
(user, date) via the PointTransaction unique key.

One board's verified fight report. Completion requires BOTH
participants' reports; awards require both to report 'win' (a lost raid
completes honestly with no award). Idempotent per command id and one
report per reporter.

get.description:
Recent heart-rate readings for the live web graph (both participants).

Honesty rules: invalid readings are returned with valid=false and their
status; the graph shows gaps instead of interpolating.
